verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents official SDKs across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java, plus a first-party GitHub JavaScript SDK repo with Eval examples. The SDKs cover tracing, prompts, datasets, and evals from code, with auto-instrumentation and drop-in wrappers. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality (one community comment calls integration options limited, but gives no concrete SDK failure).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
